title: Canvas/BlockEmbed
name: Generator
text: This is fundamentally incorrect ui/ux. these are demo controls that are accross all plugins and have no interaction / useability / relevance / control of their respective pugins - its an absolute MASSIVE UI/UX bug and content gap. the blocks embeddings should be bespoke and tailored to each block / node type - for simple modfier / build-in signal flow / midi modfication / utility blocks, these should have pre-built user interfaces which can be controlled directly without having to open the plugins - but until these controls can be identified and appropriately implemented for each bespoke plugin, the main block embedding should have as useful as ui/uzx design as possible - in an ideal world - it would be a visual preview or live view (scaled) of the actual plugin UI for each identification. failing that - useful block processing information such activity, cpu usage, midi / audio / effect type / plugin name / color / user name etc. for now - the block embeded content needs a ground up re-think and redesign and rebuild.
